svg.title: UC3 — SO09 issueReferral (CO9, Iteration I pp. 12-13)

g.text: UC3 — SO09 issueReferral (CO9, Iteration I pp. 12-13)
Successful SO08 supplies p and issuer through controller attributes.
Specialty and optional receiver references resolve to existing objects.
recordActivity creates/registers ActivityRecord as shown in SO08.
[receiver supplied and not receiverMatches (E3c; retain context)]
select another receiver or none; retry M3
At least one matching professional practises
at a ClinicLocation; an open slot is not required.
no internal referral for this specialty
create(p, issuer, medSpecialty, clinicalReason, receiver?, today)
Initial priority/status policy is unresolved in CO9.
Recording is one logical all-or-nothing action; earlier audits remain.
Detached failed objects never enter recorded domain collections.
No database or persistence framework is prescribed.
No Appointment is created by issueReferral.
